common.style: 2D mobile idle RPG character sprite, cute chibi, thick clean dark outline, flat cel shading with one soft highlight, high saturation, readable at small size
common.silhouette: Simple bold silhouette recognizable at 60px tall. Big simple eyes. Identity comes from ONE strong element — the helmet, the hat, the hood, the weapon — not from fine detail. Each of the eight must be distinguishable from the others by silhouette alone.
common.attitude: A human adventurer who thinks they are the hero of this story. Confident, a little smug, never frightening. This is the ENEMY the player fights, so it should read as 'punchable' rather than 'scary'.
common.facing: Facing the viewer in a slight 3/4 turn toward the viewer's LEFT (these characters face the player's party, which stands on the left). Full body, feet on an invisible ground line at the bottom edge.
common.composition: Single character, centered, filling about 80% of the frame height. Square frame. Fully transparent background — no ground shadow, no platform, no backdrop.
common.constraints: No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no frame, no border, no watermark. No blood, no gore. Weapons are stylised and chunky, never pointed at the viewer.
common.negative: monster, slime, text, letters, numbers, UI, HUD, frame, border, watermark, background, scenery, ground shadow, platform, multiple characters, photorealistic, gore, horror, grimdark, dull desaturated colors, busy tiny details, pixel art, dithering

poses.add: standing at ease, weapon lowered, calm confident expression
lunging forward to the viewer's LEFT in mid-attack, body stretched toward the left target, weapon driven forward
recoiling to the viewer's RIGHT, body squashed and leaning away, eyes squeezed shut, weapon dropping
collapsed flat on the ground, limbs limp, eyes as closed curved lines, defeated but comical not gruesome

promptTemplate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent sprite sheet for 2D mobile idle RPG. Square 2048x2048 sheet, exact 2 by 2 equal square cells, NO visible grid, no labels. Render the SAME character — {item.scene} — in four poses in ONE image, consistent identity, palette, volume, outline and light source across all cells. Top-left idle: {pose.idle}. Top-right attack: {pose.attack}. Bottom-left hit: {pose.hit}. Bottom-right dead: {pose.dead}. {common.style}. {common.silhouette} {common.attitude} {common.facing} Each pose entirely inside its own cell with ample transparent margin, same implied floor baseline at 85% down each cell, consistent body mass. {common.composition} {common.constraints}
